## Conditions

1. If a payment date falls on a bank holiday, the payment is taken on the next business day.
2. A payment more than 10 days late is charged a late fee of $25.
3. You may pay off all or part of the loan early at no charge.
4. A change of address or employer must be reported to us within 30 days.
5. BlueRiver Credit Union holds the title to the vehicle until the loan is paid in full.
